items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: we made some of those first recordings with Billie... with Korby, Ben, I think it was Benny Goodman... But we all made those first recordings.

ctx.x: catch her on the cymbals. Well see, well that's very unprofessional with Ben Webster taking a solo and you're up there trying to catch Blanche Calloway when she's kicking her legs upin the air on the cymbal. You know that was one of the troubles.
I'm sure Ben didn't appreciate that.
Oh no, but he couldn't do anything about it because it was Blanche's band. That's what she wanted, you know. So.
